top_choice_rationale: P001 (Mircea Cărtărescu alone) is the only proposal naming a writer, and it rests on literary grounds under the common criteria: a distinctive voice, formal ambition sustained across long architectures (Blinding and Solenoid, as publicly known), and a continuing project that builds memory, the body and dream into one metaphysical structure. The citation should be scoped to the prose, with poetry as lyric context, because translation coverage of the poetry and early work is thinnest. A peaks-and-overall-direction standard suits a whole-oeuvre judgment. Whether Solenoid reorganizes the earlier architecture or restates it remains unsettled without close reading or expert reports. That is a real uncertainty, but it does not defeat the case, and the fallbacks (Adonis, Tawada) are less verifiable for us. This judgment rests on public knowledge and translation, with no independent source verification and no reading of the Romanian originals. The agreement across all six round-2 files may reflect shared sources and correlated reasoning, so it is not evidence of merit. P000 ranks below P001 because the shared reservations are about verification and do not show a lack of literary achievement.
recusal_note: None apparent from the profile, which shows no personal, institutional or professional tie to any shortlisted writer. My scholarly work on the fragment, exile literature and Paul Celan overlaps thematically with Adonis and Tawada, my named alternatives. This is context and not evidence of preference, and it is disclosed and not adjudicated.
